jobs.title: Field Refrigeration Quality Assurance Specialist
jobs.description_text:
Vixxo is seeking a full-time Field Refrigeration Quality Assurance Specialist.

Position Summary

The Field Install Quality Specialist– Refrigeration is responsible for overseeing installation quality and ensuring commercial refrigeration systems installed by regional contractors meet Vixxo, Walgreens, and OEM specifications. This role serves as Vixxo's on-site technical representative throughout the installation process, performing field inspections, identifying and resolving deficiencies, validating installation documentation, and ensuring all closeout requirements are met before submission.

This position requires extensive knowledge of commercial refrigeration systems, HVAC/R installation practices, construction quality standards, and contractor oversight. Significant travel throughout an assigned multi-state territory is required.

Why This Role Exists

Vixxo installs walk-in cooler and freezer refrigeration systems for Walgreens across the country using a network of regional contractors. Walgreens holds every install to a written spec and reviews every closeout package photo by photo. This role is Vixxo's person on the roof and in the box: making sure the install matches the spec while the crew is still on site, and making sure the closeout is complete and correct before it leaves the store.

Job Responsibilities

  • Travel to assigned installation

jobs.description_text:
Vulcan Elements is manufacturing American rare-earth permanent magnets for a secure future. With a focus on national security and economic resiliency, we serve critical industries such as defense, aerospace, and automotive powering a high-technology future. Vulcan Elements is building a team of ambitious professionals committed to Mission Focus, Technical Excellence and Integrity.

As the Security and Emergency Services Manager you will own physical security and emergency preparedness for Vulcan Elements manufacturing operations, based primarily at the Benson, NC facility with supporting responsibility for the Durham, NC R&D site. This is a build-it role: you will stand up the site security program as Benson comes online, establish the physical safeguards required for handling export-controlled technology and Controlled Unclassified Information, and create the emergency services program from the ground up — drills, response plans, an internal emergency response team, and working relationships with the fire, EMS, and law enforcement agencies who will show up when something goes wrong. This is a full-time, day shift, on-site position with on-call responsibility for after-hours incidents.

jobs.title: Recruiter
jobs.description_text:
Xantium Group is looking for a Recruiter to join at a pivotal point in the Firm’s growth, with the opportunity to shape the talent coming in and the processes behind how we recruit. You'll lead searches across quantitative research, trading, and analysis, bringing the market knowledge and judgment to identify and attract exceptional candidates.

jobs.title: Senior Recruiter
jobs.description_text:
Our Mission

You call. You wait. You call again. In every other part of your life, you book in seconds. In healthcare, you’re blocked.  

We’re here to give power to the patient. 

For nearly 20 years, we’ve built the leading healthcare marketplace - helping tens of millions of people find and book the care they need. Now, we’re going further: building our infrastructure beyond Zocdoc’s marketplace to power access to care wherever patients search, from provider websites and insurance directories to search engines, AI platforms, and more.

Healthcare still lacks something every other major consumer industry takes for granted: a seamless way to go from seeking to getting. We don’t want to own the front door to care; there isn't one. We want to make sure all of those doors open when patients are knocking.

Fixing healthcare starts with fixing access to it. And we're still just getting started.

 

Your Impact on Our Mission:

Zocdoc’s most important asset is our people.  As a Senior Recruiter, you’ll play an essential role in our company’s growth. Your ability to think outside of the box to identify, attract and close the nation’s best talent, paired with your passion for creating an efficient and highly personalized candidate experience will impact our employees and patients for years to come. <

jobs.description_text: We are looking for a Customer Value & Growth Program Manager to own and drive the company-wide program that ensures our customers realize the value of their investment with Achievers and incrementally grow their spend with us as a result. Customer Success, Product, Marketing, Marketplace, Enablement, Revenue Operations and Finance each own a piece of this today. You will sit at the centre, pulling those pieces into one integrated strategy, guiding and collaborating with each team as they build their part, and making sure everything we do aligns to a consistent vision. You are accountable for making sure the right plans exist, that they connect, and that the functions who deliver them are set up to execute. Your impact comes from how well you align, equip and drive the people closest to our customers. The role goes beyond program management. You won't just report the numbers - you'll explain what happened, forecast what comes next, and actively shape the strategy and direction to help support growth. From building predictive models and share-of-wallet analyses to partnering with Customer Success on NRR strategy and existing customer ARR forecasting, this is a role for someone who wants to make a measurable impact across the business. If you bring experience from e-commerce, retail, or a rewards/marketplace environment, that's a significant advantage, you'll hit the ground running with an intuitive understanding of redemption and e-commerce dynamics, catalogue economics, and customer purchasing behavior that are central to this role.
